x: Broadbent, after qualifying as fastest loser. 1 mile Junior: 5th, M. Stearman. 880 yards: 2nd, Cope, in 1.59. 100 yards Junior: 6th J.

In the 100 yards, Broadbent won his heat in 10.7; qualified in the second round and was third in a 10.4 final. Cope was third in his 880 yards' heat. In the mile Marchant qualified in 4.31 and Burfitt in 4 mins 33 secs.

This was held at Tooting and in the senior match Gordon Lowers won the 100 yards in 10.6 secs. and John Cope won the 440 in 52.7 secs. Cope also turned out in the 220 and gained a point by filling fourth place.
100 yards: 1st, Lowers, 10.5 secs. 220 yards: 1st, Sexton, 23.4 secs. 440 yards: 1st, Cope, 53.6 secs.; 3rd, Underwood. 880 yards: 1st, Marchant 1 min. 59.5 secs.; 3rd, A.
In the 440 yards both Cope and McKenzie failed to make an appearance and it is a pity that when chaps are sent a card that they do not reply if they cannot turn out.
A great win for John Bicourt, who beat old rivals Cope, Church and Badgery in fine style. These four were well away and a full minute separated the first and fifth runners at the finish.
